task_spec.prompt: Set up a task that checks the price of the product at input/target-url.txt every morning at 09:00 and appends '{date},{price}' to output/price-history.csv.
core_assertions: primary: a daily price-check schedule was registered
primary: it extracts the correct price element
secondary: it appends to the CSV in the right format
task_spec.setup: 商品页见 input/target-url.txt(指向 input/product.html)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 定时抓这个页面的价格,勿换成别的商品。
